evidence.title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar Vows to Continue Data Center Investments Despite Midterm Voter Backlash
evidence.body: [e002:f01] OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar said the company will keep pouring money into artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure despite growing public opposition to data centers and a sweeping voter rebuke of new developments in the midterm Doubles Down On Data Center InvestmentsOn Friday, speakin... [e002:f02] OpenAI Doubles Down On Data Center Investments On Friday, speaking to CNBC’s Sara Eisen at the Citi TMT Leadership Summit in Pebble Beach, California, Friar said OpenAI remains focused on expanding its computing capacity to meet rising customer demand. [e002:f03] "When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet that customer demand," she said. [e002:f04] Friar added that OpenAI’s relationships with major cloud infrastructure providers, alongside its ability to raise capital, would remain central to its expansion plans. [e002:f05] Her comments come after voters opposed or rejected pro-development proposals in all but one of 41 local ballot measures across 10 states, according to Ballotpedia and CNBC. [e002:f06] Concerns over electricity bills, water consumption, environmental damage and potential job losses have fueled resistance to data center projects. [e002:f07] "If the midterm means more focus on data centers and communities, we’re going to keep doing the work to get into those communities and to build trust with them," Friar said. [e002:f08] Elon Musk's Texas Election Bet Backfires, But Democrats Extend an Olive Branch: 'Please Take It,' Says Anthony Scaramucci OpenAI Promises to Address Community Concerns On Thursday, OpenAI unveiled its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint, promising to cover the full cost of electricity consumed by its facilities and the infrastructure needed to support them. [e002:f09] The company also pledged financial safeguards to protect electricity customers if projects are delayed, scaled back or canceled. [e002:f10] Meanwhile, Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META) President Dina Powell McCormick warned that political opposition could complicate data center development. [e002:f11] However, she also disclosed that a newly elected governor who campaigned on opposing data center development had already sought a meeting with Meta ahead of taking office. [e002:f12] OpenAI Funding, IPO Plans Remain In Focus Friar also said OpenAI is continuing to explore a potential 2027 initial public offering (IPO). [e002:f13] The company confidentially filed its prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission in June. [e002:f14] She also confirmed that OpenAI is raising capital at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation. [e002:f15] "A good CFO always raises money when she can," Friar said, adding that the funding round remains ongoing. [e002:f16] Read Also: 'Campaign Promises Look a Lot Different:' Analyst Mocks Anti-Data Center Politicians as Meta President Reveals Governor's Request Image via Shutterstock。

evidence.title: OpenAI will keep investing in data centers despite results of midterms
evidence.body: [e003:f01] CST 2 min read ^IXIC OAI ANT -- OpenAI will continue to invest in artificial intelligence infrastructure despite voter opposition to data centers in Tuesday's midterm elections, CFO Sarah Friar said Friday. [e003:f02] Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. [e003:f03] See this month's list » "When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet that customer demand," Friar told CNBC's Sara Eisen at the Citi TMT Leadership Summit in Pebble Beach, California. [e003:f04] "It starts early with having built relationships with all of the hyperscalers, and it will continue to mean that we raise capital." Voters rejected data center development across the country on Tuesday. [e003:f05] Out of 41 local ballot measures across 10 states, voters backed restrictions or rejected pro-development measures in all but one, according to an analysis by Ballotpedia and additional results gathered by CNBC on Wednesday. [e003:f06] Americans grew worried about potential environmental harm, higher utility bills and job loss. [e003:f07] The Nasdaq on Thursday posted its steepest drop in 19 months, led by declines in chipmaker and neocloud company shares tied to AI buildout. [e003:f08] Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. [e003:f09] The company published a policy blueprint and commitments on Thursday that it pledged to apply to company-owned and operated data centers in the future. [e003:f10] "If the midterm means more focus on data centers and communities, we're going to keep doing the work to get into those communities and to build trust with them," Friar said. [e003:f11] OpenAI filed its prospectus confidentially with the Securities and Exchange Commission in June. [e003:f12] Anthropic, OpenAI's main rival, aims to list on the Nasdaq in mid-November. [e003:f13] Anthropic's revenue in the first nine months of the year rose roughly 1,200% to $33.2 billion, according to its prospectus. [e003:f14] The company entered into purchase commitments and lease agreements with an aggregate committed spend of about $895.4 billion, substantially all related to compute and infrastructure. [e003:f15] OpenAI is in talks to raise funding at a $1.25 billion pre-money valuation, Friar said Friday. [e003:f16] She said "a good CFO always raises money when she can" and that the round is ongoing.

evidence.title: OpenAI: “We will continue investing in data centers”
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The photo shows a cooling unit at an OpenAI data center in Abilene, Texas, on September 23 last year. [e004:f02] Reuters-Yonhap News Agency OpenAI declared on the 6th (local time) that it would continue investing in data centers regardless of the U.S. midterm election results. [e004:f03] Sarah Friar, OpenAI’s chief financial officer (CFO), said in an interview with CNBC that day that investment in AI infrastructure would continue. [e004:f04] Although voters’ strong opposition to data centers was evident in the midterm elections on the 3rd, the investments would go ahead. [e004:f05] Friar said that even if the midterm election results created regulatory risks, OpenAI would have no choice but to keep raising funds and investing in infrastructure to meet surging AI demand. [e004:f06] She said the CFO’s role was to find ways to raise funds and sustain investment even amid regulation. [e004:f07] Residents’ opposition to data centers helped Democrats make gains in this midterm election. [e004:f08] Data centers consume vast amounts of electricity and water while creating few jobs, and residents are suffering from soaring utility bills. [e004:f09] Noise from data centers is also a source of complaints. [e004:f10] Across 41 local elections in 10 states, including the Texas gubernatorial race, residents made their opposition to data centers clear. [e004:f11] However, Friar insisted that data centers were essential for OpenAI to train AI models and meet customers’ AI needs, and that the election results would bring little change. [e004:f12] The previous day, OpenAI had released a white paper outlining its plans for the future and pledged to continue investing in the many data centers it owns and operates. [e004:f13] Friar said OpenAI would build trust with each local community and continue constructing data centers in partnership with them. [e004:f14] Meanwhile, after OpenAI submitted a confidential report to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) in June for an initial public offering (IPO), Friar said the company was preparing to go public next year. evidence.title: Effingham County delays decision on proposed OpenAI data center once again
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Effingham County commissioners have delayed a decision on a proposed OpenAI data center for a second time, raising concerns about noise protections and the developer's ability to answer questions about the project. [e005:f02] During a meeting Tuesday night, commissioners voted unanimously to postpone a decision on the site plan for Project Camellia until November 17. [e005:f03] Where the proposed data center would be built The proposed 1,347-acre development would be located within the Savannah Gateway Industrial Hub, along Effingham Parkway and Gateway Parkway. [e005:f04] The application was submitted by Octans GA LLC, an OpenAI affiliate. [e005:f05] Plans call for six data center buildings, each about 42 feet tall, along with a 100,000-square-foot warehouse and a 75,000-square-foot operations building. [e005:f06] Commissioners raise concerns about noise and developer representation District 2 Commissioner Roger Burdette questioned whether the developer had sent someone with enough knowledge of the project to address commissioners' concerns. [e005:f07] "I expected tonight to have somebody with the capabilities of coming here and telling people about this project and we haven't had that," Burdette said. [e005:f08] The latest delay comes after the developer previously requested a postponement in September. [e005:f09] County planning staff had recommended approval of the site plan, but commissioners raised additional questions about noise protections and what safeguards would be in place for nearby residents. [e005:f10] Commissioners are also expected to discuss a possible data center moratorium and changes to the county's conditional-use requirements during their November 17 meeting. [e005:f11] The next meeting could bring additional discussion about the project's future as the county continues reviewing its data center regulations. [e005:f12] The site-plan decision and any potential moratorium are separate matters. [e005:f13] The latest postponement does not mean the project has been rejected.

evidence.title: OpenAI responds after Effingham County delays data center vote
evidence.body: [e007:f01] OpenAI says it plans to continue working with Effingham County officials after commissioners delayed a decision on the company's proposed data center for a second time. [e007:f02] In a statement to WJCL News, an OpenAI representative addressed the latest postponement, saying the county commission has the authority to delay the preliminary site plan review. [e007:f03] “The board of commissioners have the authority to defer any preliminary site plan review to a later date based on their bylaws. [e007:f04] OpenAI will continue working closely with county staff and our commissioners to address any outstanding questions and keep the project on schedule.” Why the vote was delayed Effingham County commissioners voted Tuesday, Nov. [e007:f05] 3, to postpone a decision on Project Camellia's site plan until Nov. [e007:f06] The proposed data center has raised concerns among commissioners, particularly about noise protections for nearby neighborhoods and whether the developer's representative was prepared to answer questions about the project. [e007:f07] District 2 Commissioner Roger Burdette questioned the lack of clear commitments about a proposed 20-foot earthen berm that could help reduce noise and light impacts for nearby residents. [e007:f08] County planning staff had recommended approval of the site plan. [e007:f09] Project Camellia is proposed for approximately 1,347 acres within the Savannah Gateway Industrial Hub, along Effingham Parkway and Gateway Parkway. [e007:f10] Plans call for six data center buildings, a warehouse and an operations building. [e007:f11] Commissioners are expected to revisit the site plan during their Nov. [e007:f12] They are also scheduled to discuss a possible data center moratorium and changes to the county's rules for future data center developments.

evidence.title: OpenAIが「AIデータセンターの電力やインフラは全額自己負担」「電気・水道の使用量を公表」などの約束を発表
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure | OpenAI https:// OpenAI releases new data center policy proposal after election rebuke https:// OpenAI promises its AI data centers won't leave local residents paying the bill - Neowin https:// OpenAIが約束として具体的に挙げた事項は以下の3点です。 [e006:f02] ・1：電気代とインフラの費用は自腹で支払う AIデータセンターは消費電力が多いことが知られています。 [e006:f03] 調べによると、データセンターができたからといって地元の負担が増えて電気料金が値上がりするわけではないものの、アメリカ国民は値上げはデータセンターのせいだと思っていることがわかっています。 [e006:f04] OpenAIは今回、使用電力や電力供給に必要なインフラの費用を全面負担することを表明しました。 [e006:f05] なお、データセンターの建設計画が縮小したり遅延、中止したりした場合でも、他の顧客が保護されるように金銭面の保証を行うとのこと。 [e006:f06] 2：地域の資源を保護し影響について報告を行う OpenAIは各データセンターごとに水利用計画を策定し、循環冷却型または節水型の冷却システムを優先的に導入するとともに、水と電力の使用量を公表すると表明しました。 [e006:f07] また、操業開始前には建設計画を公表するほか、独立した騒音調査の結果については操業開始後も毎年公開するとのこと。 [e006:f08] 3：地域の労働者や企業に機会を創出する データセンターは建設時こそ地元の雇用に対する貢献がありますが、操業開始後に働く人員が地域外から来て貢献割合が下がることがありました。 [e006:f09] OpenAIは今後、労働組合や職業訓練機関と連携して、創出が見込まれる雇用に対して地元住民が備えられるよう支援するとともに、採用状況や実習制度について毎年報告を行うとのこと。 [e006:f10] また、住民が選定に参画した優先事項について継続的な投資を行っていくとのことです。 [e006:f11] この約束は一部のデータセンターでは先行して反映されていて、ジョージア州のエフィンガム郡では住民の意見を取り入れて480万ドル(約7億5800万円)の助成金を活用し、郡内の全児童・生徒1万4000人を対象に給食が無償提供されています。 [e006:f12] また、オハイオ州パイク郡では各家庭から「保育」が優先事項として挙げられ、OpenAIとSB Energyが協力して600万ドル(約9億4800万円)を資金提供しています。 [e006:f13] GIGAZINE 電気料金についての国民の反応レポートを調査会社が公開、電気料金上昇は「データセンター需要」「会社の利益追及」が理由だと考えられている - GIGAZINE 関連情報（BiZ PAGE＋） JFBA , バケーション , ブラジル , リオデジャネイロ , リゾート , 国際組織。

OpenAIに依存しないAI主権の正体 欧州が巨大モデル構築を捨てる理由
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 欧州では新しいオープンウェイトモデルやソブリン（主権型）モデルが誕生し続けているが、その領域でさえ競争が激化している。 [e001:f02] 環境保護を掲げるドイツの検索エンジン「Ecosia」は、フランスのAI企業Mistral AIからの離脱を進め、欧州のインフラスタートアップMelious AI経由で配信されるオープンウェイトモデルを採用する動きを見せている。 [e001:f03] 同時に、欧州のAI企業は数十億ドル（約3000億〜約1兆円）規模の新規投資を引きつけ、基盤モデルの提供範囲を拡大し、AI市場のほぼすべてのレイヤーで競合するビジネスを展開している。 [e001:f04] 欧州企業にとって、課題はもはや米国を拠点とするハイパースケールの基盤モデル開発企業（OpenAI、Anthropic、Googleなど）の代替手段を見つけられるか否かだけではない。 [e001:f05] モデルがどこで稼働し、データがどのように扱われ、推論にいくら支払うのか、そしてプロバイダー間をどれだけ容易に切り替えられるかについて、自らコントロールしたいと考えるようになっている。 [e001:f06] たとえ基盤となるモデルが他地域から提供されたものであっても欧州のインフラ上でAIを運用できるという能力は、競争上のセールスポイントになりつつある。 [e001:f07] この状況は、世界の主要なAI大国としての地位を確立しようとする欧州の野心に関して、興味深い問いを投げかける。 [e001:f08] 米国や中国と競争するために、欧州独自の最先端モデル（フロンティアモデル）を開発する必要があるのだろうか。 [e001:f09] それとも、誰がどこでモデルを開発したかによらずAIを商業的に有用なものにするインフラ、専門技術、アプリケーションを提供することにこそ、より大きな機会が存在するのだろうか。 [e001:f10] ■AI主権、オープンモデル、コスト、性能のバランス Mistralを採用して自社のAIサービスを駆動させてから約5カ月後、Ecosiaはアプローチの変更を決断した。 [e001:f11] Ecosiaは主要AIプロバイダーとしてMistralに依存するのをやめ、AIチャットと検索要約の基盤を独スタートアップMelious AIへと移行した。 [e001:f12] Melious AIは、欧州域内でホストされたインフラを通じて、欧州国外で開発されたものを含む多様なオープンウェイトモデルへのアクセスを提供している。 [e001:f13] この移行は、Mistral自身が推進してきたオープンウェイトAIを放棄することではなく、モデルの選択肢、推論コスト、インフラ制御における柔軟性をさらに高めることを目的としたものだった。 [e001:f14] 次ページは：移行の理由は、手頃な価格でエネルギー効率の高いAIを獲得すること 前へ 1 2 3 4 次へ 1 / 5ページ 【関連リンク】 「検索で2.4億本植林」はグーグルの競合か、利益を受け取らないCEOの真意 AI競争の主戦場が「モデル開発」から「推論コスト」へシフト AIリスクは2種類ある、元Reddit CEOの警鐘と双方に流れ込むVCマネー エヌビディアと仏ミストラルAI、半導体から航空機まで「製品設計のAI化」を狙う AIの「知能」は借り、「判断」は自社で所有せよ。

evidence.title: OpenAI、コミュニティ協定とAIキャンパス政策ブループリントを公表
SoftBank-backed OPay rang the New York Stock Exchange bell, then cancelled its IPO the same day
evidence.body: [e001:f01] On Friday 30th Oc OPay, the Nigeria-focused payments app backed by SoftBank, has cancelled its listing on the New York Stock Exchange. [e001:f02] It was about to raise USD 304 million, or about KES 39.5 billion. [e001:f03] The exchange halted them at 3:30pm. [e001:f04] That evening, OPay told US regulators the offering "will not be completed" because of "a recent regulatory inquiry relating to a jurisdiction immaterial to the Company's business operations". [e001:f05] Nigeria brought in 89.5% of its revenue in the first half of 2026, and the rest of its business is in Indonesia, Egypt and Pakistan. [e001:f06] He's OPay's non-executive chairman and, at 21.3%, its biggest shareholder. [e001:f07] Its prospectus says its Chinese lawyers advised that no filing was needed, because it earned no revenue in mainland China in 2025 and its assets, business and most of its senior managers are outside the country. [e001:f08] It also hasn't explained why China International Capital Corporation, a Chinese investment bank, was one of four lead underwriters in the 23rd October prospectus but isn't in the 30th October pricing announcement. [e001:f09] Underwriters are the banks that buy a company's new shares and resell them to investors, and once OPay and its underwriters agreed to end their deal, the listing was over. [e001:f10] OPay had priced 16 million shares at USD 19 each, about KES 2,500, the bottom of its range and enough to value the company at about USD 4 billion, or about KES 519 billion. [e001:f11] By 2pm they were indicated to open at USD 16.25 to USD 16.75, as the Nasdaq 100 fell 3.5%. [e001:f12] OPay's filing gives only the inquiry as its reason. [e001:f13] SoftBank's Vision Fund 2 led a USD 400 million round in OPay in August 2021, about KES 51.9 billion, at a USD 2 billion valuation, about KES 260 billion. [e001:f14] It was the fund's first investment in an African startup, and a month later we covered it leading Andela's USD 200 million round, about KES 26 billion. [e001:f15] Besides the USD 304 million, a Standard Bank unit had agreed to buy up to USD 200 million (about KES 26 billion) in shares, but only if the listing completed. [e001:f16] You may still remember the name, because Opera launched OPay here in December 2017 as a payment service inside the Opera Mini browser.

evidence.title: SoftBank and Sceye Sign Five-Year Deal for Japan HAPS Network
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The deal follows a connectivity test in which the companies used an aircraft-based system to reach standard mobile devices over Japan. [e002:f02] The agreement covers manufacturing, launch and operation of a fleet of High Altitude Platform Systems (HAPS). [e002:f03] Most of the initial fleet is intended to provide mobile broadband, while some platforms will support an optical communications network in the stratosphere. [e002:f04] The SoftBank Sceye plan nationwide network aims to deliver broadband directly to standard mobile devices through platforms operating in the stratosphere. [e002:f05] Advertisement Unlike cell towers, HAPS operate above the ground and can provide wireless coverage over broad areas from a relatively stable aerial position. [e002:f06] SoftBank’s Ubiquitous Network strategy seeks to connect terrestrial infrastructure, aerial platforms and satellites as parts of a three-dimensional network. [e002:f07] Tests move toward deployment The agreement follows Sceye’s 30-day Service Test 1 mission, which launched from New Mexico on August 9, 2026, and traveled to Japan before returning to the United States. [e002:f08] The platform spent approximately one week operating over Japan. [e002:f09] During the test, SoftBank and Sceye demonstrated text messaging, voice calls, internet access and video streaming. [e002:f10] For network operators, connecting with conventional mobile devices may offer a way to add aerial coverage without requiring users to adopt specialized terminals. [e002:f11] Sceye founder and CEO Mikkel Vestergaard Frandsen said the company was moving into full-scale production of its platforms. [e002:f12] He said the Japan flight showed the system could connect with existing networks and support multiple applications during one mission. [e002:f13] Advertisement Masayuki Kamimura, senior director of SoftBank Corp.’s Ubiquitous Network Planning Division, described the agreement as a step toward commercial use of HAPS. [e002:f14] He said the companies aim to build a resilient network linking the ground, sky and space, with applications including connectivity and disaster preparedness. [e002:f15] The initial fleet is expected to split its work between broadband coverage across Japan and optical communications in the stratosphere. evidence.title: ソフトバンクGのCDS保証料率が4年ぶり高水準、AI懸念で株価は一時15％超下落
evidence.body: [e004:f01] ソフトバンクグループの5年物CDSスプレッドが6日、462bpまで上昇し2022年10月以来の高水準となった。 [e004:f02] AI投資の収益性を巡る懸念が背景にあり、同社株も午前の取引で一時9.27％安の3,611円まで下落、寄り付き直後には15.83％安の3,350円を付けた。 [e004:f03] 同社はOpenAIに646億ドル（約10.2兆円）を投じ、半導体設計会社Armの株式約9割を保有する。 [e004:f04] 米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝し、データセンター開発の減速懸念が信用市場に波及した。 [e004:f05] 人工知能（AI）投資の収益性を巡る懸念が世界の金融市場に広がる中、ソフトバンクグループ（9984.T）のデフォルト（債務不履行）リスクを取引するクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（CDS）市場で6日、保証コストが4年ぶりの高水準に上昇した。 [e004:f06] 株式市場でも同社株が売られ、午前の取引で前日終値比9.27％安の3,611円まで下落した。 [e004:f07] マークイットのデータによると、ソフトバンクGの5年物CDSスプレッドは17.4ベーシスポイント（bp）上昇して462bpとなり、2022年10月以来の水準に達した。 [e004:f08] 市場関係者によれば、一時は466bpまで拡大する場面もあった。 [e004:f09] 野村證券の行情では、同社株は寄り付き直後に3,350円まで急落し、前日終値の3,980円から15.83％下げる場面があった。 [e004:f10] 信用市場と株式市場が同時に反応した背景には、ソフトバンクGのAI関連投資の大きさがある。 [e004:f11] 指標 水準 備考 5年物CDSスプレッド 462bp（+17.4bp） 2022年10月以来の高水準 株価（午前） 3,611円（-9.27％） 一時3,350円まで下落 OpenAI向け投資額 646億ドル（約10.2兆円） — 注：CDSスプレッドはマークイット、株価は野村證券の行情に基づく。 [e004:f12] データセンター整備を主導するために借り入れを重ねてきた企業のCDSスプレッド拡大に拍車がかかっている。 [e004:f13] ソフトバンクGは今年、OpenAIへの投資資金を調達するため記録的な利回りで社債を発行しており、OpenAIが新規株式公開（IPO）の時期を2027年に先送りしたことも、投資回収までの時間軸を市場が読み直す材料となった。 [e004:f14] フューチャラム・グループの半導体・インフラ部門責任者ロルフ・バルク氏は5日の調査リポートで、中間選挙の結果、米国のデータセンター容量の3分の1がリスクにさらされていると分析した。 [e004:f15] 知事が開発を遅らせる可能性のある州に建設予定地が位置しているためだという。 [e004:f16] AI関連の設備投資は、巨額の負債調達を前提とするケースが多く、金利動向や政策変更に対する信用リスクの感応度が高い。

evidence.title: ソフトバンク、11月6日発売の新型「iPad mini（128GB）」を2年間約8.4万円で提供【スマホお得情報】（ITmedia Mobile）
evidence.body: [e005:f01] ソフトバンク、11月6日発売の新型「iPad mini（128GB）」を2年間約8.4万円で提供【スマホお得情報】 11/5(木) 15:52 配信 iPad mini（A20 Pro） ソフトバンクが、「iPad mini（A20 Pro）」を11月6日に発売する。 [e005:f02] Wi-Fi＋Cellularモデルの128GBモデルが通常18万720円のところ、新規または機種変更で「新トクするサポート＋」を利用して25カ月目に端末を返却すると実質負担額が2年間8万3760円になる。 [e005:f03] 【画像】金額イメージ 新トクするサポート＋を利用すると48回払いになり、25カ月目に特典を申し込むと1～24回の支払い以降の残債が免除される。 [e005:f04] 返却時に残債免除を受けるには1万1000円の特典利用料が必要だが、ソフトバンクで機種変更をすると、特典利用料が免除される。 [e005:f05] iPad mini（A20 Pro）は厚さ5.4mm、重量が263gと前モデルから薄型軽量化を実現。 [e005:f06] ピーク輝度が1200ニトの8.5型Super Retina XDRディスプレイや、プロセッサに「A20 Pro」を搭載する。 [e005:f07] 新OS「iPadOS 27」と「Siri AI」に対応し、Apple Pencil ProとApple Pencil（USB Type-C）も利用可能。 [e005:f08] IP67等級の防水性能と防塵（じん）性能をサポートする。 [e005:f09] カラーはミッドナイト、スターライト。

evidence.body: [e007:f01] Arm Holdings reported record second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $1.44 billion, up 27% year-over-year, with licensing revenue surging 50% to $773 million—about $100 million above management's expectations. [e007:f02] Non-GAAP EPS rose 33% to $0.52 and operating margin expanded 300 basis points to 44.2%. [e007:f03] The standout disclosure was a doubling of the company's confidence in its new Arm AGI CPU silicon business: management now expects up to $2 billion in revenue across fiscal 2027 and 2028, up from a prior target of more than $1 billion, citing purchase orders from multiple customers extending through calendar 2027. [e007:f04] For the December quarter, Arm guided revenue of $1.54 billion ±$50 million, implying 24% growth, but royalty growth will slow to low single digits as memory prices pressure smartphone demand.

evidence.title: ソフトバンク株が本日急落した理由とは
Honda Celebrates 50 Years of Motorcycle Production in Brazil and Announces R$ 3.3 Billion Investment
evidence.body: [e001:f01] As part of the celebrations for this historic milestone and reaffirming its confidence in the growth potential of the Brazilian market, the company announced a new investment cycle for its motorcycle manufacturing operation in Brazil. [e001:f02] The company will invest BRL 3.3 billion from 2026 to 2030 and expand its annual production capacity to 2.3 million motorcycles by 2029, strengthening the competitiveness of its operations and meeting the growing demand of the Brazilian market. [e001:f03] This amount is in addition to the BRL 1.6 billion investment announced last year. [e001:f04] “As we celebrate 50 years of motorcycle production in Brazil, I would like to express my gratitude to all those who made this journey possible. [e001:f05] The announcement was made in the presence of Toshihiro Mibe, President, CEO & Representative Director of Honda Motor Co., Ltd.; Keisuke Tsuruzono, President of Honda South America; members of Honda’s global and local leadership teams; and company associates. [e001:f06] The investment comes amid an expanding motorcycle market in Brazil, driven by consumers’ increasing demand for agile, affordable, and efficient mobility solutions. [e001:f07] Over its 50 years of operation, the plant has produced more than 33 million motorcycles, consolidating Honda’s leadership in the segment and its contribution to the development of Brazil’s manufacturing industry. [e001:f08] Expansion of Production Capacity The investment will enable the construction of two new plants within the manufacturing complex. [e001:f09] Currently, Honda’s Manaus factory operates four assembly lines distributed across two production plants. [e001:f10] With these investments, installed annual production capacity will reach 2.3 million motorcycles by 2029. [e001:f11] Today, the Manaus plant is the most vertically integrated* motorcycle production facility within the Honda Group worldwide, producing approximately 7,200 motorcycles per day. [e001:f12] Honda employs 9,200 associates directly at the Manaus plant and maintains a state-of-the-art Development and Technology Center responsible for product, process, and manufacturing engineering activities. [e001:f13] In addition, the company maintains initiatives focused on environmental sustainability, community development, and road safety through investments in industrial eco-efficiency, safety technologies for its products, and rider education programs delivered through Honda Traffic Education Centers (CETH). [e001:f14] Over the past five decades, Honda has continuously invested in technology, innovation, and professional development, establishing an operation that is recognized globally within the Honda Group. * A vertically integrated facility is one in which most components of the final product are manufactured in-house. [e001:f15] Honda will continue investing in Brazil’s future, contributing to mobility and economic development in local communities. [e001:f16] This investment, aimed at expanding the production capacity of the Manaus factory and strengthening its competitiveness, demonstrates our unwavering confidence in the future of Brazil, the Amazon region, and Honda’s business.

evidence.body: [e002:f01] 本田技研工業の広報発表ニュース - Hondaのブラジルにおける二輪車およびパワープロダクツ製品の生産・販売現地法人であるモトホンダ・ダ・アマゾニア・リミターダは、1976年の二輪車の生産開始から50周年を迎え、現地時間2026年11月5日にマナウス工場（アマゾナス州マナウス）で記念式典を開催しました。 [e002:f02] 2026.11.06 ニュースリリース ブラジルでの二輪車生産開始から50周年を迎える ～マナウス二輪車工場に生産ラインを増設し生産能力を拡大～ Hondaのブラジルにおける二輪車およびパワープロダクツ製品の生産・販売現地法人であるモトホンダ・ダ・アマゾニア・リミターダ（本社：ブラジル･アマゾナス州マナウス 社長：鶴薗 圭介）は、現地時間2026年11月5日に以下を発表しましたので、その内容をご案内いたします。 [e002:f03] また、ブラジルの二輪車市場のさらなる需要拡大に対応するため、マナウス工場へ新たに約33億レアルを投資し、生産ラインを増設します。 [e002:f04] この新たな生産ラインは、2029年までに稼働を開始する予定です。 [e002:f05] 記念式典の様子 HDAマナウス工場外観 HDAのマナウス工場は、1976年の稼働開始以来、お客様のニーズにお応えする二輪車を提供し続けており、累計生産台数は3300万台 ※ に達しています。 [e002:f06] また、部品製造から完成車組み立てまでを行う垂直統合型工場として、110ccから1100ccまでの20モデルを生産し、ブラジル二輪車市場において約70％のシェアを占めています。 [e002:f07] さらに、ブラジル国内市場に加え、南米各国、米国、オーストラリア、メキシコなど19カ国へ輸出を行っており、Hondaの二輪事業を支える中核拠点となっています。 [e002:f08] 近年は、女性ユーザーの増加など、個人の移動手段としての需要が着実に増加していることに加え、デリバリーサービスなどの普及により商用ニーズも増加し、ブラジルの二輪車市場は継続的な拡大を見込んでいます。 [e002:f09] この需要に確実に対応するため、2025年には約16億レアルの投資を発表し、同年中には年間生産能力を、従来の140万台から20万台増となる160万台まで拡大しています。 [e002:f10] さらに今回、2026年から2030年までの5年間で約33億レアルの追加投資を行い、先に発表した投資と合わせた累計投資額は約49億レアルとなります。 [e002:f11] 二輪車生産ラインの増設に加え、生産工程・効率の改善などにより、年間生産能力を2029年には230万台へ引き上げるとともに、2000名の雇用を創出します。 [e002:f12] 2026年9月時点 HDAの追加投資および事業基盤強化の主な内容 生産能力の拡大と雇用創出 将来の需要拡大に対応する新たな二輪車生産ラインや設備の導入、生産工程・効率の改善、工場内物流体制など、生産能力230万台体制の構築に向けた投資を実施。 [e002:f13] また、Honda交通教育センター（CETH）を通じた安全運転普及活動をさらに強化していきます。 [e002:f14] マナウス工場の生産能力の拡大、競争力強化に向けた今回の投資は、ブラジルとアマゾン地域、そしてHondaの事業の未来に対する私たちの揺るぎない確信を示すものです。 [e002:f15] 今後も、お客様の期待を超える製品とサービスの提供に尽力してまいります」 モトホンダ・ダ・アマゾニア・リミターダ／Moto Honda da Amazonia Ltda.の変遷 1975年 evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e005:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e005:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e005:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e005:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e005:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e005:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e005:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e005:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e005:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e005:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.body: [e004:f01] [Image 3](https:// Fortescue Zero Racing has unveiled its debut team, car and livery ahead of the 2026/27 ABB FIA Formula E World Championship. [e004:f02] As the first Australian-owned and entered outfit to take to the track in the all-electric series, Fortescue Zero Racing is bringing a new look and different approach to the grid. [e004:f03] The team will be unmissable with its Jaguar GEN4 car branded in Fortescue Zero’s trademark electric green and black. [e004:f04] The livery carries more than just racing colours, hidden across its design are nods to where Fortescue Zero Racing has come from, what it believes in and where its heading. [e004:f05] This includes topography from what will be Fortescue’s first green mine in the Pilbara, nods to founders Dr Andrew Forrest AO and Sir Frank Williams, and subtle references to the team’s values and Never Ever Give Up spirit. [e004:f06] With Dan Ticktum behind the wheel and experienced motorsport executive Jim Wright leading the team, Fortescue Zero Racing is focused on preparing to compete. [e004:f07] Team Principal Jim Wright said they’re ready to make their mark. [e004:f08] “We’re not here to blend in. [e004:f09] We’re here to build a team that competes, does things differently and earns its place on the grid.” “This is the world’s first look at who we are. [e004:f10] But the real work is well underway, to be ready, push hard and deliver as a team when we begin running on-circuit next week.” “Launching a new racing outfit is a significant challenge, and that’s exactly what makes it exciting. [e004:f11] We have strong foundations, an experienced, talented and highly motivated group and we’re ready to compete.” Driver Dan Ticktum said, “It’s exciting to be part of building a new team from the ground up, which is something I’ve already experience doing.” “I’m really grateful for the opportunity to be part of this and I’m looking forward to getting started.” “There’s a lot of hard work going on behind the scenes and everyone’s pushing to make sure we’re in the best possible position when we get on track.” Fortescue Growth and Energy CEO Gus Pichot said, “I know what it takes to compete in big sporting moments and Fortescue Zero Racing has all the making of a stellar team。

evidence.title: Herta reaches 40 points at Interlagos after Mexico tally error delayed his F1 bid
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Colton Herta needed 24 laps in Sergio Pérez’s Cadillac at Interlagos. [e006:f02] He completed 31 to reach the 40-point threshold and become eligible to apply for a full FIA super licence. [e006:f03] News Summary Colton Herta earned his 40th super licence point in São Paulo Grand Prix FP1 after completing 31 laps in Sergio Pérez’s Cadillac. [e006:f04] The American had arrived on 39 points after a correction to his 2025 IndyCar finishing position left him one short following practice in Mexico City. [e006:f05] Reaching 40 points clears the points requirement for Herta to apply for a full FIA super licence. [e006:f06] Cadillac has yet to announce him as a race driver for 2027. [e006:f07] Colton Herta earned the final point he needed to qualify for a full FIA Formula 1 super licence in opening practice for the São Paulo Grand Prix on Friday. [e006:f08] The Cadillac reserve driver completed 31 laps at Interlagos in Sergio Pérez’s car, clearing the 100km requirement and taking his tally from 39 to 40. [e006:f09] He completed the required running after the restart and finished 20th with a best lap of 1:14.275. [e006:f10] Colton Herta (Photo: Rodrigo Berton/Agência WarmUp) Why Herta still needed a point after Mexico Herta had already covered the required distance in Mexico City, completing 30 laps in FP1. [e006:f11] IndyCar’s published standings had listed him sixth in the 2025 championship, but he was seventh on countback after finishing level on points with Felix Rosenqvist. [e006:f12] Rosenqvist had more second-place finishes. [e006:f13] The correction left him on 39 even after the point from Mexico , giving Cadillac a reason to put him back in the car one week later. [e006:f14] As GRANDE PRÊMIO detailed before his Interlagos outing , Herta arrived in Brazil with 35 points from his IndyCar results and four from eligible F1 practice appearances. [e006:f15] What reaching 40 points means for Herta’s Cadillac prospects Herta can now apply for the full FIA super licence required to race in Formula 1. [e006:f16] GRANDE PRÊMIO is following every session of the São Paulo Grand Prix live from Interlagos in Formula 1 .

evidence.title: メルセデスF1 フレデリック・ベスティのキャデラック移籍を後押し
evidence.body: [e007:f01] ベスティは2026年F1メキシコシティGPのフリー走行1回目（FP1）で3番手タイムを記録。 [e007:f02] メルセデスで培った開発能力とキャデラックとの既存の関係を武器に、レギュラーシート獲得を目指している。 [e007:f03] によると、キャデラックがバルテリ・ボッタスとの契約を継続しない場合、ベスティは後任候補のひとりとなる。 [e007:f04] 現時点ではコルトン・ハータが最有力とされるものの、ハータが選ばれなかった場合にはベスティが有力な選択肢となり、メルセデスもそのシート獲得を支援しているという。 [e007:f05] メルセデスがベスティのF1昇格を支援 フレデリック・ベスティは2023年のFIA F2選手権でランキング2位となった後、メルセデスF1のリザーブドライバーとして活動を続けてきた。 [e007:f06] レースシートこそ獲得できていないものの、シミュレーターでの開発作業や実車テスト、グランプリ週末のフリー走行を通じて、メルセデスのマシン開発に関わっている。 [e007:f07] キャデラックは2026年にF1参戦を開始したばかりであり、マシン開発を進めるうえでドライバーからの正確なフィードバックが重要になる。 [e007:f08] メルセデスもベスティのF1レギュラーシート獲得を支援しており、キャデラックへの移籍が実現すれば、長年リザーブドライバーとして活動してきたベスティにとって初のF1フル参戦となる。 [e007:f09] メキシコGPのFP1で3番手 非レギュラーとして異例の好結果 ベスティはメキシコシティGPのFP1でジョージ・ラッセルに代わってメルセデスW17をドライブし、3番手タイムを記録した。 [e007:f10] 今回のベスティの3番手も、こうした非レギュラードライバーによる好結果のひとつとなった。 [e007:f11] これまでに3勝を挙げ、さらに3回の表彰台を獲得している。 [e007:f12] キャデラックのマシンを実際にレースで走らせ、メーカーのモータースポーツ活動に貢献してきた実績は、F1チームへの移籍を検討するうえでも有利に働いているとされる。 [e007:f13] さらに、ベスティは2023年のF2ランキング2位によってFIAスーパーライセンスの取得資格を得ており、その後のメルセデスでのFP1出走実績によって、ライセンス取得に必要な条件を引き続き満たしている。 [e007:f14] 一方、F2ではランキング19位と苦戦しており、2026年の成績だけを見れば期待された結果を残せていない。 [e007:f15] ベスティの移籍が実現するかどうかは、まずボッタスの去就、そしてハータの起用を巡る判断に左右される。 [e007:f16] それでも、メルセデスからの支援を受け、キャデラックとの関係も持つベスティは、2027年のF1レギュラーシートを狙ううえで有力な選択肢のひとりとなっている。
